title: A sales report in a few collects
hints: A two-level `groupingBy` (region, then product with `summingDouble`) gives every total you need for the best product (lesson 8.03).

For the tie rule, compare entries by value and then by key in reverse, so `max` picks the alphabetically first key among equal values: with `Comparator<Map.Entry<String, Double>> byTotal = (x, y) -> Double.compare(x.getValue(), y.getValue());`, that is `byTotal.thenComparing(Map.Entry::getKey, Comparator.reverseOrder())`.
